text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-d n-o-t f-i-l-e t-h-e s-a-f-e-t-y d-e-f-e-c-t s, l-e-f-t i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l m-e-m-o r-i-z-i-n-g t-h-e f-a-i-l, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y c-o-r-r-e-c-t-i-o-n p-l-a-n r-e-v-i-e-w.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-a-g-g-e-d u-n-a-u-d-i-t-e-d b-l-o-c-k-s a-s a-p-p-r-o-v-e-d, l-e-f-t u-n-v-e-r-i-f-i-e-d b-a-t-c-h r-e-c-o-r-d-s a-s p-r-o-o-f, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e q-u-a-l-i-t-y s-i-g-n-o-f-f b-e-f-o-r-e d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-m-o-v-e-d w-a-r-n-i-n-g l-a-b-e-l-s f-r-o-m p-a-c-k-a-g-i-n-g, l-e-f-t p-l-a-i-n u-n-m-a-r-k-e-d c-a-s-t o-f t-h-e s-a-m-e s-t-y-l-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e p-r-o-d-u-c-t l-a-b-e-l a-u-d-i-t s-t-e-p.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-a-st o-r d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y d-e-c-i-s-i-o-n, l-e-f-t c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n t-r-a-i-l-s a-s r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r y n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-a-l-e-d t-h-e i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y b-e-f-o-r-e r-e-v-i-e-w, l-e-f-t u-n-r-e-c-o-v-e-r-a-b-l-e o-r-d-e-r l-o-g-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-r-k-e-t p-l-a-c-e m-a-n-d-a-t-e s-t-o-p-p-i-n-g p-o-i-n-t c-h-e-c-k.
